tested_scope: One bounded eight-history logical model of a stale proposal carrying {repository_node_id, generation, effect_id}. Compared (A) current repository-node plus visible-generation CAS with repository-local effect record, (B) an abstract rollback-domain-independent sink that atomically checks current incarnation + minimum generation + durable effect_id, and (C) a sink floor/effect record that is missing or rolled back with repository-visible state. No external sink was mutated and no additional public source was read in this leaf.

authority_observation.observation: Both authorized write surfaces are paths in the same GitHub repository rollback/delete domain being analyzed. The frozen role control authorizes no rollback-domain-independent sink write and forbids scheduler mutation and protected-primary authority mutation.

candidate_A_repository_only.rule: Require proposal repository_node_id == current node_id, proposal generation == repository-visible generation, and use only repository-local effect_id state for dedupe.
candidate_A_repository_only.interpretation: Current-node/CAS checks fence known cross-incarnation or visible-generation mismatch, but do not survive rollback that removes the higher-generation/effect witness from the same repository domain.

candidate_B_abstract_durable_sink_floor.rule: At the authoritative sink, atomically require proposal incarnation == durable current incarnation I2, generation >= durable minimum_generation 4, and consume/dedupe effect_id in the same rollback-domain-independent state transition.
candidate_B_abstract_durable_sink_floor.interpretation: The combined incarnation floor + monotonic generation floor + durable effect-id consumption is sufficient for these eight histories only. This is a mechanism requirement, not evidence that an allowed Chat-native sink implementing it currently exists.

candidate_C_missing_or_rolled_back_floor.rule: Use current-node/visible-generation checks but allow the sink generation floor and effect-id record to be absent or rolled back with visible repository state.
candidate_C_missing_or_rolled_back_floor.interpretation: A floor that shares the rollback domain or loses its effect-id memory is not a freshness/idempotency fence.

result.new_positive_evidence: Within the bounded model, sink-time atomic validation of {current incarnation, minimum generation, effect_id} is sufficient to reject both stale-generation replay and duplicate retry even when repository-visible state is rolled back.
result.new_falsification: Repository-only CAS/current-node checks plus repository-local idempotency state are insufficient when the higher generation or prior effect record can be rolled back/deleted with the repository. A sink floor that is missing or shares that rollback domain fails for the same reason.
result.minimal_unresolved_child: Find a Chat-native authoritative sink or in-band authority primitive that can durably and atomically enforce current incarnation + monotonic minimum generation + effect-id dedupe outside the repository rollback domain, while requiring no protected/admin/manual setup, no richer-mode execution, no external hosted coordination, no finite monthly/trial/paid quota and zero incremental cost. If every such surface violates one of those constraints, preserve the impossibility boundary rather than accepting repository-local state.

observation_vs_inference.observed: Frozen role config restricts this worker's writes to two repository-local namespaces; Part100 established only a narrow current repository-incarnation discriminator and did not establish rollback-proof freshness.
observation_vs_inference.inferred_from_model: An atomic rollback-independent sink floor would close the modeled stale/duplicate histories, but no such allowed surface was demonstrated in this invocation.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.repository_transport_rate_limit_dependen: bounded GitHub state transport only; no API volume used as compute

Do not treat absence of an authorized non-repository write surface in this role config as a global proof that no Chat-native product surface exists.
